| [03-switch-summary-to-search-mode.md](./03-switch-summary-to-search-mode.md) | Switch from summary mode to search mode |
| [04-full-teardown-clean-data.md](./04-full-teardown-clean-data.md) | Full teardown and data cleanup |

| [06-bootstrap-fresh-machine.md](./06-bootstrap-fresh-machine.md) | Bootstrap VSS source on a fresh machine |
